author: Cleo Abram
description:
This is the most controversial car on the internet. 

Ferrari just broke the rules with the Luce, the first-ever all-electric Ferrari that many thought would never exist. 

I’m joined by design legends Jony Ive and Flavio Manzoni at a secret track in Italy to reveal the radical technology and "crazy details" behind this controversial masterpiece. 

It’s more than just a supercar, it’s Ferrari’s biggest risk yet. To learn about the the design... subscribe!

title: The FIRST Ferrari Electric Car
